title: Ukrainian Tomato Casserole
description: A traditional Ukrainian dish featuring tomato puree and herbal flavors, perfect for a low-fat meal prep option. This casserole is a bouncy and flavorful meal that can be enjoyed at any time of day.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, cook the ground beef over medium heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Stir in the dried thyme, salt, and black pepper.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked brown rice, tomato puree, and cooked ground beef mixture.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake for 25 minutes, then remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
If desired, top with low-fat sour cream before serving.
